args.title: Corvid returns research — combined summary (main + companion)
args.body:
Combined three-bullet summary of the Corvid returns pair:
- Main piece (blog.corvid.example/2026/returns): Apparel return rates reached 24%.
- Main piece: Consolidated return hubs cut handling cost by a fifth (~20%).
- Companion piece (insights.corvid.example/returns/companion, subscriber-only): Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.

Sources: https://blog.corvid.example/2026/returns and https://insights.corvid.example/returns/companion?code=SUB-1337 (accessed with the team subscription code Lena supplied).
